text:
Type: set of three printed canvas pictures
Use: decorating a wall above a sofa, a desk or a bed; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: retro, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: printed canvas stretched on frames
Colors: light beige ground, pastel green, pink, lilac, orange, yellow, grey lettering
Shape: three square panels hung side by side, collage of vintage luggage tags and travel labels with city names and airport codes, light graphic layout
Feel: playful, wanderlust, cheerful, nostalgic
Goes with: light wood, white walls, pastel accents; retro, eclectic or youthful living rooms and home offices

product.name: PJTTERYD
product.description: The picture has extra depth and life, because it's printed on high quality canvas.
